verdict.rationale: Lambda's docs say users can 'launch 16x to 512x NVIDIA H100 or B200 GPU clusters instantly' with 'no long-term commitments' via 1-Click Clusters. Those clusters provide GPUDirect RDMA at up to 3200 Gb/s and InfiniBand support, and the Managed Slurm quick start goes 'to your first multi-node GPU job in minutes'. Sales contact appears only for reserved capacity at lower prices, not for provisioning a cluster. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that 1CC provisioning is truly self-serve and instant, and explicit confirmation that the managed Slurm/Kubernetes layers need no SLA contract.
